skills.name: Inspired Scholarship
skills.description:
Etch a series of runes onto your weapon that pulse with power once every |cffffff3|r seconds. Each pulse enhances your Arcanist skills, and striking an enemy with one deals an additional |cffffff3570|r Magic Damage and generates Crux if you have none.

While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

skills.name: Cephaliarch's Flail
skills.description:
Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing |cffffff7820|r Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

If an enemy is hit, you for heal for |cffffff3483|r Health, once per cast.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

skills.name: Pragmatic Fatecarver
skills.description:
Channel a beam of energy in front of you for up to |cffffff4|r seconds, dealing |cffffff3545|r Magic Damage every |cffffff0.3|r seconds to up to 6 enemies. While channeling, you also gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff9278|r damage and grants interrupt immunity.

Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by |cffffff33|r%, and decreases cost by |cffffff16|r% per Crux spent.

This ability is considered direct damage.

skills.name: Killer's Blade
skills.description:
Thrust a caustic blade with lethal precision to stab an enemy, dealing |cffffff4432|r Disease Damage. Deals up to |cffffff400|r% more damage to enemies with less than |cffffff50|r% Health.

Heals you for |cffffff8344|r if the enemy dies within |cffffff2|r seconds of being struck.

skills.name: Echoing Vigor
skills.description: Let loose a battle cry, instilling you and your allies with resolve and healing for |cffffff18171|r Health over |cffffff16|r seconds.

skills.name: Shooting Star
skills.description:
Call a comet down from the constellations to blast an enemy, dealing |cffffff16392|r Flame Damage to all enemies in the area, knocking them down, and stunning them for |cffffff2|r seconds.

One second after impact, enemies in the target area take |cffffff4432|r Flame Damage every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff10|r seconds.

You generate |cffffff10|r Ultimate for each enemy hit by the initial blast, up to 6 times.
